_schema_note: Every case here is executed with a deterministic mock/monkeypatch — no real provider outage is ever caused. Each case names the exact injection point (module.function to monkeypatch) so run_failure_eval.py's implementation is traceable to this spec, not ad hoc.

cases.injection_point: app.services.gemini_client.GeminiClient.generate (or groq_client, per active provider) raises LLMTimeoutError
cases.expected_detection: AppError caught by the global handler (core/error_handlers.py), taxonomy_category='tool'
cases.expected_recovery: tenacity retry (up to 3 attempts) exhausted -> mapped HTTP error status, not a hang or unhandled 500 traceback
retry per tenacity config; exhausted retries surface a clean error, not a corrupted partial answer

cases.injection_point: LLM client raises a generic 5xx-shaped LLMAPIError

cases.expected_detection: agent_graph/nodes.py::retrieval_node re-raises (does NOT silently degrade — this was a real bug found and fixed during Phase 1, see git history) rather than swallowing the exception
cases.expected_recovery: propagates to ChatServiceError (500) for /chat, or an SSE error event for /chat/stream

cases.injection_point: context.vector_store is None when retrieval_node runs
cases.expected_detection: retrieval_node's explicit pre-check (the one intentional degrade case, distinct from fail_004)
cases.expected_recovery: state.error_type='retriever', root_cause='vector_store_unavailable', workflow terminates safely with a fallback answer rather than crashing

cases.expected_detection: existing degrade-on-rerank-failure path in retrieval_service.retrieve (falls back to unranked hybrid/vector results)
cases.expected_recovery: request still completes with un-reranked chunks, not a hard failure
degrades to an empty result list; the corrective loop proceeds without web context rather than failing the whole request

cases.expected_detection: agent_graph/nodes.py::vision_node re-raises (Phase 1 fix — no fallback path exists for a failed diagnosis, so it must not silently degrade)
cases.expected_recovery: propagates as a clean error to handle_diagnose's caller
ChatService._generate_structured falls back to the plain free-text _generate path — structured output is a win-when-it-works enhancement, never a new failure mode
route_after_approval returns 'safe_finalizer', never 'resume' — the guarded action never executes

cases.injection_point: monkeypatch rag_service._MAX_LLM_CALLS down to a value already exceeded by a query needing >2 regenerations, or force build_chat_graph(max_steps=1)
cases.expected_detection: engine.py logs graph_cycle_capped_max_steps; core/metrics.py agent_loop_limit_hits_total increments
cases.expected_recovery: returns whatever answer exists at the cap, does not loop indefinitely

cases.injection_point: POST /chat with an empty query string, or a query exceeding any configured length limit
cases.expected_detection: validate_request_node rejects empty query (workflow_status='failed', termination_reason='validation_failure') / Pydantic request validation for length limits
